Lord '''Astalor Sunsworn''' is the Lord-Regent of Quel'Thalas,<ref name="A Good Day" /> the patriarch of House Sunsworn, and a current member of the [[Regency Council]] of [[Alah'Thalas]]. One of the surviving nobles of Quel'Thalas, Lord Sunsworn is amongst those most opposed to [[Vereesa Windrunner]], having aspirations to ascend to the throne himself and establish his own dynasty to replace House Sunstrider as rulers of the Quel'dorei.

==Biography==
Unlike other nobles of Silvermoon, Lord Sunsworn had kept his coffers in the vaults of [[Ironforge]], allowing him to maintain his vast fortunes even after the fall of Quel'Thalas. He would host lavish feasts for his fellow lords and ladies, though despite his claims that he opened his doors to the less fortunate as well,<ref name="A Good Day" /> he would requisition supplies meant for the impoverished of Quel'Thalas for feasts meant for his own supporters.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|8|A Feast for the Poor}}</ref>

=== Scars of the Past ===
Lord Sunsworn was the one who convinced the Regency Council to open up [[Sunstrider Court]], a grand coliseum that was built within Alah'Thlas, to mercenaries, champions, and wanderers from all corners of Azeroth, each hoping to prove their strength, earn gold, or fight for something greater.<ref>[[Patch 1.18.0#NEW ARENA — SUNSTRIDER COURT]]</ref>

===Nightmares of Ursol===
In search of salvation for the Quel'dorei's magical addiction, Lord Sunsworn sent his cousin [[Andanil Sunsworn|Andanil]] to [[Moonwhisper Coast]] with an expedition in search of [[draenethyst]].<ref>[[Andanil Sunsworn#Quotes]]</ref> However, the expedition force did not send word back in weeks, prompting him to send an adventurer in search of Andanil.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|53|Sunsworn Expedition}}</ref>

===''[[A Good Day]]''===
Following a campaign by the [[Silver Covenant]] to retake [[Shalandis Isle]], Lord Sunsworn exposed Vereesa Windrunner's funding for her campaign as having come from diverted funds intended for their people in exile and taxes that were owed to the Council, undermining her attempt at reclaiming her position as Speaker. As the ground that had been taken could not be forfeited to the Scourge after the matter had been disclosed, he made a motion before the Regency Council to have him be named Lord-Regent of Quel'Thalas, ostensibly to provide a strong leader to the people of Quel'Thalas in the dark times to come. With the five votes required from his fellow council members, he was named Lord-Regent of Quel'Thalas.<ref name="A Good Day" /><ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/528228771594240030/1447325402925109309 Lhian from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] - "its what happens between the high elf into and future quel thalas patch"</ref>

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Vereesa's ineptitude in rallying Alliance forces to reclaim Quel'Thalas marks the last straw. I refuse to witness our proud race reduced to a puppet state of Stormwind. With our reliance on the Alliance military, we stand exposed to the threats of both the Scourge and the resurgent Amani tribe.

It is only a matter of time until others recognize my rightful claim to leadership. The Sunsworn dynasty shall ascend, and under my rule, we will endure for countless millennia. The era of vulnerability and subservience is over; the domination of the Quel'dorei shall be reestablished, unyielding against external threats.

==Speculation==
He may be related to [[Priestess Maelah Sunsworn]] and [[Ranger Rubinah Sunsworn]].
